title: Sequoia raised ~$10B in new funds, and announces it is shutting down its Arc accelerator and Scouts program, merging its early-stage and growth teams, and more (Connie Loizos/TechCrunch)
summary: Connie Loizos / TechCrunch: Sequoia raised ~$10B in new funds, and announces it is shutting down its Arc accelerator and Scouts program, merging its early-stage and growth teams, and more — Sequoia Capital posted a memo to X on Wednesday morning titled “The Sequoia of Tomorrow” that's full of surprises.
